translations./abilities/0/description: RO-1 learns to move and steer. Every mission starts with motion.
translations./abilities/1/description: RO-1 learns to answer the signal tower: hear the call, then set out.
translations./abilities/2/description: RO-1 learns to read a map: find the available roads before choosing how to travel.
translations./abilities/3/description: RO-1 learns to tell tires apart. Different surfaces need different shoes.
translations./abilities/4/description: RO-1 learns to compare motors. Force and top speed come with a tradeoff.
translations./abilities/5/description: RO-1 learns to measure distance. LiDAR becomes its pair of eyes.
translations./abilities/6/description: RO-1 learns to plan a route around obstacles instead of pushing through them.
translations./abilities/7/description: RO-1 learns to locate itself. It must know where it is before it can reach somewhere else.
translations./abilities/8/description: RO-1 learns to read the ground. Pavement, gravel, and sand each behave differently.
translations./abilities/9/description: RO-1 learns to assemble a complete build whose parts work together.
translations./abilities/10/description: RO-1 masters the build: there is no best part, only the right combination.
translations./abilities/11/description: RO-1 learns Ackermann steering: it has a steering angle, cannot turn in place, and must respect a minimum radius.
translations./abilities/12/description: RO-1 learns tracked motion: skid steering rewards patience and stable control.
translations./abilities/13/description: RO-1 learns to drive tracks on sand. When slip blurs the route, slow becomes fast.
translations./abilities/14/description: RO-1 learns to steer on sand. Turning early gives the chassis time to respond.
translations./abilities/15/description: RO-1 learns to recognize slip. Spinning wheels do not guarantee body motion.
translations./abilities/16/description: RO-1 learns long-haul pacing. A steady speed is quick, and gentle power saves energy.
translations./abilities/17/description: RO-1 learns stable low-speed travel. The watchdog remembers, and the controller recovers from oscillation.
translations./abilities/18/description: RO-1 learns to handle wet ground. When traction falls, braking distance grows.
translations./abilities/19/description: RO-1 learns that waiting is an active maneuver: depart as soon as the corridor opens.
translations./abilities/20/description: RO-1 learns to observe frequently. Extra range cannot replace timely measurements.
translations./abilities/21/description: RO-1 learns to cross an intersection: let the side threat pass, then enter the safe opening.
translations./abilities/22/description: RO-1 completes the first town job across wet pavement, gravel, sand, and patrol traffic.
translations./abilities/23/description: RO-1 completes a multi-stop delivery through five districts, three crossings, vehicles, and pedestrians.
